marta (PM): Quick check-in for ACME pilot. Target 2026-04-01. Need to pin minimal launch scope and owners for three gates: runtime KV change, tenant CMK onboarding, and staging prewarm capacity. Short answers pls.

alex (Eng): I can own runtime KV change. Need a 4-item acceptance checklist from product. Is temporary canary without CMK allowed?

sam (Runtime): Temporary canary OK if fallback isolates tenant data + emits audit. Note: KV change may add ~8ms p95; will bench.

jess (Infra): Two prewarm choices: burstable hosted (fast, quota request ~3d) or Dedicated pool (1wk+). Recommend burstable to meet dates.

casey (SRE): If burstable, put alert to convert: sustained_utilization >70% for 2h. Ill own runbook and escalation.

li (Security): CMK onboarding needs HSM + rotation policy review; earliest slot 2026-03-18. If canary runs sans-CMK, provide data-separation doc and ENC-in-transit proof.

alex (Eng): Proposed checklist: 1) E2E on ACME test tenant with prefix cache; 2) simulated KMS failure validated; 3) staging p95 <120ms; 4) canary flag + rollback path.

marta (PM): Add security sign-off (li) and infra prewarm applied (jess).

sam (Runtime): I'll post perf matrix + tuning options by Fri EOD. If p95 high, suggest adaptive batching.

jess (Infra): Opening INFRA-4321 today; quota request in flight. ETA pool ready 48h after quota approval.

li (Security): Need design doc + threat model by Thu noon. If delayed, list mitigations.

casey (SRE): ops-bot note: maintenance 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC; canary deploys blocked then. Will flag runbook.

marta (PM): Action items: alex: delivery plan + rollback flag (Thu COB); sam: perf matrix (Fri EOD); jess: INFRA-4321 + provisioning; li: security sign-up; casey: alert & runbook. Reply with "ack" on your line.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack (posting perf to /perf/results)

jess (Infra): ack (INFRA-4321 link posted)

ops-bot: Reminder: do not schedule canary during maintenance window.
thread_text_short: Concise cross-team sync to lock ACME pilot gates: runtime KV, CMK onboarding, prewarm choice; owners ack and action items.
